plans.buy_case: TECH shows classic mean-reversion setup: Bollinger Band squeeze with histogram turning up, golden cross intact, and price holding above 200MA—textbook reversal into an uptrend. RSI at 56.6 is neutral (not oversold), but the technical confluence and above-average volume suggest institutional accumulation ahead of a breakout.
plans.entry_condition: Wait for RSI to pull back into your 20-30 buy zone OR price to touch the lower Bollinger Band (~$70.90). Do NOT chase at current levels—your edge is mean reversion, not momentum chasing.
plans.exit_condition: Take profits at upper Bollinger Band (~$76.50) or if RSI exceeds 70 on heavy volume (profit-taking signal). Hard stop: close below 200MA (61.12) or MACD histogram rolls over again.
plans.risk: Fundamental data gap is a red flag—insufficient earnings/guidance intel limits conviction. Healthcare biotech is sector-sensitive; broader market weakness or company-specific news could invalidate the setup. Position size ($288) is appropriately small relative to your portfolio, but ensure this isn't hiding a data-gathering miss.
plans.notes: This is a *conditional* buy, not an immediate entry. Your discipline around waiting for RSI to cool into your zone is what separates good swing traders from impulsive ones. Do a 10-minute dive into recent TECH earnings and guidance before pulling the trigger—the technicals are clean, but you need at least surface-level fundamental confidence for a quality company rule.

plans.buy_case: BAX is flashing a textbook mean-reversion setup: RSI 35.1 in oversold territory, price pinned to the lower Bollinger Band, with a Bollinger Band squeeze suggesting volatility compression before a breakout. The 200MA filter is clean (price above it, golden cross intact), and elevated volume confirms institutional interest—this is the exact setup your system rewards.
plans.entry_condition: Enter on a break above the lower Bollinger Band (~$23.50) with RSI still <40, OR wait for RSI to dip to 25-28 for maximum oversold confirmation. Do not chase; patience here maximizes edge.
plans.exit_condition: Take profits at RSI 65-70 (overbought exit) or when price touches upper Bollinger Band. Hard stop at $23.00 (below lower BB and 200MA support). Exit early if BAX gaps down >2% on negative healthcare news or sector rotation.
plans.timeframe: 3–6 weeks; this is a mean-reversion play, not a position trade.
plans.risk: Healthcare sector is event-driven (FDA news, earnings, regulation); BAX's 'hold' rating and neutral fundamentals mean no tailwind if technicals fail. Position size ($309) limits damage, but watch for sudden negative catalysts that can break the 200MA support hard.

plans.buy_case: MTD is flashing classic mean-reversion setup: RSI 31.9 in oversold territory, price pinned near lower Bollinger Band after a squeeze, and MACD histogram bottoming with upside inflection. Golden cross (50MA > 200MA) + price anchored at 200MA provides structural support for a swing bounce.
plans.entry_condition: Wait for RSI to dip to 25-28 range OR price to touch lower BB (≈$1,275). Confirm with MACD histogram crossing above zero. Do NOT chase at current 31.9—let weakness come to you.
plans.exit_condition: Sell 50% at 50MA (1362)—take quick 6-7% profit. Trail stop on remaining 50% to 1320 once price clears 1350. Exit full position if RSI exceeds 70 or price breaks below 200MA (1317) on close.
plans.timeframe: 3-5 weeks (mean reversion typically snaps back fast in quality names)
plans.risk: Fundamental headwinds not disclosed in briefing could extend oversold condition. MTD is expensive (~$1,293 share price) relative to portfolio size—one bad earnings miss could whipsaw hard. Also: healthcare sector rotation risk if rates spike unexpectedly.
plans.portfolio_note: At $3,771 portfolio value, a single share represents 34% concentration. Consider sizing to 2 shares max ($2,575 = 68% allocation) to respect position limits. This is a tactical bounce, not a core hold.

plans.buy_case: SWK is textbook mean-reversion setup: RSI 34.8 in oversold zone, price pinned to lower Bollinger Band, and healthy 200MA structure (golden cross intact) suggests institutional support. Bollinger Band squeeze + above-average volume indicates coiled energy ready to snap back toward 50MA resistance.
plans.entry_condition: Wait for RSI to dip to 28-30 (slightly deeper oversold confirmation) OR price to kiss lower BB one more time. Do NOT chase at current 34.8—you want better risk/reward. Enter on intraday weakness, not strength.
plans.exit_condition: Take profit when RSI reaches 60+ OR price touches 50MA (~$94.28). Hard stop loss at $85.80 (below lower BB and 200MA). If RSI divergence appears on daily candles, exit immediately—means momentum is faking.
plans.timeframe: 2-4 weeks. This is a quick mean-reversion trade, not a multi-month hold. Take the 7-8% and rotate.
plans.risk: Fundamental deterioration (earnings miss, guidance cut) could break through 200MA support hard. Also: industrials are cyclically sensitive—macro slowdown could negate technical setup. VIX is calm NOW but that can change fast. Do NOT hold through earnings if imminent.
plans.additional_notes: Your $268 position (3 shares) is appropriately sized for a $3.7k portfolio (7% risk). The *caveat* is real: you MUST verify recent earnings, debt levels, and forward guidance before committing. SWK has had rough patches—don't let pretty technicals blind you to deteriorating fundamentals. This is a tactical trade, not conviction buying. If fundamentals check out, execute.

plans.buy_case: VTR is exhibiting textbook mean-reversion setup: price squeezed near lower Bollinger Band with MACD turning up from valley, all anchored above the 200MA. The golden cross and above-average volume suggest institutional accumulation into a healthcare REIT with solid fundamentals. RSI at 43 gives room to run without being overextended.
plans.entry_condition: Enter on a touch of the lower Bollinger Band (~$88.50) OR if RSI dips into 30-35 zone on any intraday pullback. Do NOT chase above $91; wait for the pullback.
plans.exit_condition: Take profits at first target ($94.50, ~6% gain) if RSI hits 65+. Hard stop at $87.00 (below lower BB + 200MA support). Also exit if MACD histogram rolls over or dividend cut news breaks.
plans.risk: Healthcare REITs are rate-sensitive; a Fed pivot toward higher rates could kill the bounce. Occupancy trends and dividend sustainability are black boxes without deep fundamental research—news gap is real. Position size ($270) limits damage but means opportunity cost if VTR rips 15%+.
plans.note_for_busy_student: This is a low-maintenance trade once entered: set alerts at $94.50 (sell target) and $87.00 (stop), then ignore it. Check earnings calendar before entry to avoid surprises. VTR is liquid enough to exit cleanly at market open if needed.
